Anthropic Weighs New AI Model
Anthropic is thinking of launching a new AI model as GPT-6 Astra gains traction with businesses and developers, Reuters reported Friday, citing three sources.
The company is also evaluating the safety of its next model and how much to invest in new releases as it works to improve profitability, according to the report.
The deliberations come shortly after CEO
Dario Amodei
called for a slower pace of AI development over safety concerns.
Anthropic did not immediately respond to Benzinga’s request for comment.
